name: huashu-design
description: Huashu Design 3.0 · 在 agent 里打一句话，拿回能交付的设计：网页 / App 原型 / 可编辑 PPTX / 动画 / 信息图 · 六个候选挑三个方向 · 84 种带样张的风格库 · 越用越懂你的外观账本与设计体检 · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
one_liner: A Chinese-market design tool where typing one sentence into an AI agent gets you back a finished deliverable — a web page, app prototype, editable PowerPoint, animation, or infographic.
buyer: A marketing freelancer or small agency serving Chinese-speaking clients who needs fast, presentable pitch decks, prototypes and infographics without hiring a designer.
business_use_cases: A marketing freelancer generates client pitch decks and infographics same-day instead of waiting on a designer.
A startup founder produces an app prototype and a launch animation for investor pitches without design budget.
A small agency offers rapid-turnaround deliverables (decks, infographics, prototypes) as a premium same-day service tier.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a same-day turnaround design service for pitch decks and infographics to startups and freelancers.
Bundle it into a monthly content/marketing-materials retainer for small clients.

steal_this: Produce three sample deliverables (a deck, an infographic, a short promo animation) this weekend for your own portfolio, then pitch same-day design turnaround to local Chinese-speaking small businesses.
